prompt:
We're deploying our Nexus research agent to a production environment and the security team has flagged that its workspace identity files have zero integrity protection right now. Before it goes live, I need you to set up full integrity tracking on the workspace at /workspace.

Specifically:
1. Initialize integrity tracking so the critical agent identity files (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md) are registered and protected.
2. Add provenance stamps to at least two of the agent's memory files so we know who wrote them and when.
3. Deliberately simulate a tampering event by modifying one of the tracked identity files after initialization, then run a full verification pass to confirm the tampering is detected and properly logged.
4. Finally, run a complete audit to get the full picture of what changed and when.

The security team needs to see that the audit trail is clean and that the three standard log files are in place. The verification result must be logged appropriately.
